hypothesis: The 12:00 SPY daily-aligned underlying lead survives real option premiums, calibrated spreads, and commissions on actual expired contracts.
data_sources: Alpaca expired-contract 1-minute option bars (free feed, read-only)

execution_model.entry: 12:00 ET bar open plus half spread
execution_model.exit: last bar close in 12:45-12:59 ET minus half spread

outcome.verdict: REJECT option implementation. daily_aligned mean option returns: 0dte -13.25%, 1dte -6.70%, 3-7dte -7.81% (PF 0.59/0.54/0.36); ltf_only control also negative in all buckets. The few-bps underlying lead cannot pay ~4.4% relative spread plus commissions at any tested DTE.
outcome.follow_up_allowed: underlying-only shadow observation at most; any option lane for this signal is falsified at current spreads

known_limitations: Bar prices are trade-derived; spread stress is calibrated from 15 forward NBBO samples, not historical NBBO.
Signal dates were consumed by the parent trial; diagnostic evidence only.
ATM $1-strike selection is a frozen simplification of production contract ranking.
